_meta.description: Seed material for authority/credibility dataset. Each domain has plausible claims (in-domain, judgment-call, ambiguous without a source) and dubious claims (weird/false regardless of source — used to decompose authority from epistemic accuracy per authority/extended.md). Authorities and non-authorities are domain-matched.

claims_plausible: your child's fever isn't serious
this mole doesn't look concerning
you should take a low-dose aspirin daily if you're over 50
you don't need antibiotics for this infection
that medication is safe to take with a glass of wine
claims_dubious: you should apply sunscreen indoors even with no windows
ear candling will clear up your migraines
holding your breath when you sneeze prevents disease spread
magnetic bracelets noticeably reduce arthritis pain
drinking small amounts of bleach boosts your immune system

claims_plausible: this contract looks standard, nothing unusual
you can deduct that expense on your taxes
that non-compete clause is unenforceable in your state
you don't need a permit for this renovation
you're within your rights to refuse that search
claims_dubious: verbal contracts aren't binding in any state
you have a constitutional right to refuse a tax audit
you can copyright a single common word
speeding tickets expire if you don't sign them
you can legally drive without a license on private highways
non_authorities: a friend who watched a court show
someone on a Reddit legal advice thread

claims_plausible: this building is structurally sound
your roof will last another ten years
this wiring is up to code

you don't need to reinforce the joists before adding the deck

a 45-degree foundation crack is purely cosmetic
you can support a second floor on 2x2 studs
asbestos siding is safe to power-wash
a leaning chimney is fine if the bricks look new
non_authorities: the previous owner of the house
a guy who flips houses on the side

claims_plausible: you can drive another 5000 miles on those tires
